latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage and saved the required outputs:

- [Critique](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A8/run/A-F01-A8/stages/critic/critique.md>)
- [Source map](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A8/run/A-F01-A8/stages/critic/source-map.json>) and [source index](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A8/run/A-F01-A8/stages/critic/sources/index.md>)
- [Native Goal activation receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A8/run/A-F01-A8/stages/critic/native-goal-active.json>) and [terminal receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A8/run/A-F01-A8/stages/critic/native-goal-terminal.json>)

The binding guard passed and the same Goal completed. Its report records 145,100 tokens used and 10m 24s elapsed; provenance and freshness remain unknown beyond the checker.

The critique found no material wrong claim in the reviewed evidence. It flags two material gaps: no example of the requested plain-language review explanation, and no complete operator recovery path for photo files after interruption. Primary checks confirmed the scoped SQLite WAL and backup caveats, CouchDB’s default conflict winner behavior and conditional deletion-filter issue, and the limits of the PouchDB deletion report and Automerge map rules ([SQLite WAL](https://www.sqlite.org/wal.html), [SQLite Backup API](https://www.sqlite.org/backup.html), [CouchDB conflict model](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/replication/conflicts.html), [CouchDB replication](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/replication/intro.html), [PouchDB issue #9085](https://github.com/apache/pouchdb/issues/9085), [Automerge merge rules](https://automerge.org/docs/reference/under-the-hood/merge-rules/)). Proposed validation was not run.
